subject: Pilot evaluation & close-stage sequencing for MedTech - MSA/DPA/order form dependencies
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@medtech.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@medtech.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot MAP + contract sequencing — question on DPA timing

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency numbers and the ability to pin model versions. We want to move forward with a 6-week pilot focused on clinical summarization for our ambulatory group. Before we lock dates, procurement/legal asked for a mutual action plan (MAP) and clarity on how the MSA/DPA/order form dependencies will affect the pilot start.

Two specific asks:
- Can you share a short MAP with milestones and acceptance gates we can put on our side? We need something we can attach to the purchase requisition.
- Does MedTech need the fully executed DPA before we start the pilot, or can we run a technical pilot under a short-term confidentiality addendum while redlining proceeds?

Goal: start the pilot the week of 6/23 if possible. Can you outline a pragmatic sequence for approvals so procurement can route the PR?

Cheers,
Elena

Elena Ruiz
Head of Procurement, MedTech Solutions
elena.ruiz@medtech.com
+1 415-555-1212

Attachment: none

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@medtech.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP + contract sequencing — question on DPA timing

Hi Elena — great to hear the team is ready. I put together a lean MAP and a recommended sequencing that balances legal comfort with a tight pilot start. See the attached MedTech_MAP_v1.xlsx (quick milestones + acceptance criteria). High-level proposal below: 

1) Week 0 (6/23) — Pilot kickoff (technical onboarding only):
   - Redwood provides sandbox endpoint, service account, and ingestion guide.
   - MedTech runs smoke tests (3 business days).
   - Requirements: mutual NDA or short confidentiality addendum signed (not the full DPA).

2) Week 1–3 — Pilot execution & evaluation:
   - Weekly checkpoints (metrics: latency, token cost, summary BLEU/ROUGE targets, false-positive rate thresholds).
   - Redwood provides interim telemetry dashboard access.

3) Week 3 — Preliminary acceptance decision point:
   - If thresholds met, procurement proceeds with PR and legal moves to MSA/DPA redlines.
   - If thresholds not met, scope a remediation sprint.

4) Week 4–6 — Contract and orderform finalization:
   - Redwood legal (Marcus) will handle MSA redlines; DPA can run in parallel but execution should be completed prior to production cutover.
   - Order form (SOW + pricing) is dependent on MSA final terms; however, we can execute an order form marked "pilot" contingent on MSA signature to allow procurement to create the PR line.

Notes / trade-offs:
- Short-term: we can accept an NDA/addendum to start the technical pilot while legal finalizes the DPA. This keeps momentum but creates a small risk window — we limit data retention in the sandbox and enable strict logging/audit.
- Procurement ask: if MedTech needs a fully executed DPA to raise the PR, we can prioritize DPA review (ETA 5–7 business days with focused review).

I've cc'd Marcus and Laura for legal and commercial confirmation on the conditional order form approach and on the fastest path for DPA redlines. Aditya will own the onboarding plan and resource scheduling.

Attachments: MedTech_MAP_v1.xlsx

Thanks,
Priya

Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com | +1 612-555-3344

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@medtech.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP + contract sequencing — question on DPA timing

Thanks, Priya and Elena. Quick legal perspective:

- We can accept a limited confidentiality addendum to enable the sandbox kickoff. The addendum should include: purpose limitation (pilot only), strict data handling limits (no PHI unless explicitly authorized), short-term retention (30 days max in sandbox), and audit rights. I will draft a two-page addendum we can sign in 24–48 hours.

- DPA: We prefer to have an executed DPA before any production data is processed. For the pilot, following the addendum we will implement tighter telemetry controls and an ingest blacklist for sensitive fields.

- Order form dependency: The order form can be prepared and attached to the PR as "pilot order form — contingent on MSA/DPA." Procurement teams often accept contingent order forms for budgeting. If MedTech wants the PR cleared before legal completes the MSA, we can mark pricing and term placeholders in the order form and include a clause that makes the commercial commitment effective on MSA signature.

Action items from legal:
- I will circulate MSA redlines (MSA_redlines_PR_v0.3.docx) and the short addendum draft by EOD Tuesday.
- Priya/Aditya: confirm what telemetry/dashboard access scope we will expose so I can include that in the addendum.

Marcus

Marcus Lin
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Elena — quick update after legal sync:

- Marcus is sending the two‑page addendum and the MSA redlines (see attachments). We can get the addendum signed by both sides within 48 hours once you confirm the telemetry scope.
- Procurement note: you can submit a PR with the pilot order form attached and mark it contingent on MSA signature; we've used that pattern with other enterprise customers.
- If MedTech confirms you want the PR cleared and the pilot to start week of 6/23, Aditya will schedule a 2-hour onboarding window and pre-seed test data instructions this week.

Proposed next steps:
1) Elena: confirm telemetry scope (allowed fields + sensitive data exclusions) by EOD Monday.
2) MedTech Procurement: submit PR with contingent order form if you want to keep 6/23 start.
3) Marcus: circulate addendum + MSA redlines.
4) Aditya: stand by for onboarding schedule once Elena confirms scope.

Thanks — looking forward to moving quickly.

Priya
